title: Events (events.json)
description: Living-world events: rules that find their own cast and change the world. Stories come from these meeting each other, not from scripts.

$schema.description: Path to this file's schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

event.description: A living-world event. Its cast is found by conditions, so the same event can play out between different people each time.

trigger.description: When the engine considers it. 'manual' events run only through trigger_event.

cast.description: Roles filled in order, each from the first qualifying candidate chosen by the game seed. The event doesn't fire when a required role stays empty.

items.description: One part in the event, filled when it fires.

role.description: Name used in the event's checks and effects as {"role": name}.

from.description: Where to look: every living character, those in the player's location, or the player's party.

when.description: A candidate qualifies when this holds, with 'self' as the candidate. Earlier roles can be used.

optional.description: The event can fire without this role.

when.description: Must hold, after the cast is filled.

chance.description: Chance to fire each time it is considered.

weight.description: When several events could fire at once, the relative likelihood of this one.

cooldown.description: Days before it can fire again.

repeat.description: Whether it can fire more than once.

notify.description: Show its messages to the player. Off-screen events between NPCs usually don't.

text.description: Shown when it fires, if notify is on.

effects.description: What happens. Use the choose effect to give the player a decision.
